subject.title: msteams: support Copilot-only streaming without enabling Teams DM streaming

question: Should the msteams plugin add a supported Copilot-only streaming config surface, and should that surface be a targeted copilotStreaming option or a generic streamingBySurface map?
rationale: This is a new feature/config contract rather than a broken existing behavior, and the durable config shape plus reliable Copilot detector need maintainer ownership before implementation.

options.title: Add targeted Copilot streaming config
options.body: Introduce a narrow copilotStreaming setting that overrides the global streaming mode only when proven Copilot activity metadata is detected.

options.title: Add generic surface map
options.body: Introduce streamingBySurface for teams/copilot/unknown, which is more flexible but creates a larger long-term config contract.

options.title: Keep global streaming only
options.body: Leave msteams streaming as one global mode until live Copilot metadata and user demand justify a new public config surface.

recommendation.title: Add targeted Copilot streaming config
recommendation.body: Introduce a narrow copilotStreaming setting that overrides the global streaming mode only when proven Copilot activity metadata is detected.

likelyOwner.reason: BradGroux has adjacent msteams config history and the related Microsoft tracker context, making them the best visible routing candidate for the config/product shape decision.
